prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 7 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 2 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 1 test (+9.0%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.5%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in 2 tests, while copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Generation Waiting Screen: Redesigns the waiting screen with a stage layout focused on real-time rendering status and animated companion preview. (why: Median time on home/waiting step is high (201s / mean 2336s) and users write support emails when app stalls or pet fails to show on desktop.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Customization & Sound Preview Flow: Adds an audio customization step into the adoption flow where users test and select voice pitches and audio responses. (why: Lesson showed adding interactive setup screens improved onboarding funnel conversion by up to +15.4%.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Summon & Quick Control Launch Screen: Adds a final screen demonstrating shortcut keys and system tray controls for managing and hiding the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Status Card: Adds step-by-step progress diagnostic text items on the waiting screen. (why: Wait info updates previously won 3 tests (up to +5.7%) and help address issues with app stalling before display.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Split Layout Redesign for Sign In Options: Changes sign_in layout to split format with data safety guarantees on the left panel. (why: Sign in is the second largest funnel loss (75.8% conversion) and layout changes previously won up to +8.7%.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Trigger: Enables system notifications on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering finishes. (why: Median waiting time is 201s, causing users to minimize the app and lose track of onboarding.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from wait times and support emails, but redesigns carry mixed historical risk.
New flows showed no positive impact in lessons and -0.2% on adoption step.
Finish new_screen has proven +9.5% average lift and addresses explicit support emails.
Wait_info on home has consistent mild positive lift (+1.3% across 11 tests).
Targets sign_in step with large user loss (24.2%); sign_in layout has +1.6% historical average.
